cover_headline: Rupee Settles 65 Paise Higher at 92.67 to the Dollar in Fifth Straight Session of Gains

end.headline: Rupee Settles 65 Paise Higher at 92.67 to the Dollar in Fifth Straight Session of Gains
end.line: A fifth straight session of gains, powered by ₹84,290 crore of foreign equity inflows in nine November sessions and weaker crude, took the rupee past a level it last closed above on April 10.

facts: On Friday, November 20, the rupee settled 65 paise higher at 92.67 (provisional) against the US dollar
Foreign investors pumped in ₹84,290 crore into Indian equities over nine trading sessions from November 2 to 13
$1,000 now converts to about ₹92,670, compared with about ₹94,190 at the November 13 close

quote.role: Research Analyst, Mirae Asset Sharekhan, quoted by PTI
quote.speaker: Anuj Choudhary
quote.text: We expect the rupee to trade with a positive bias on strength in the domestic markets and sustained foreign inflows.
